name: Yerba mate
description: Holly leaves dried and steeped, drunk through a metal straw from a shared gourd.

tcm.note: Outside the classical record; a bitter caffeinated infusion; read with tea, which is cooling.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; tikta and caffeinated; read as ushna.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; outside the record.

histamine.note: SIGHI groups mate with green tea: mild in itself, and a DAO blocker.

stimulant.note: The one common drink with all three methylxanthines. Theobromine is milder and longer-acting than caffeine, which is why mate is described as sustained rather than sharp.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.
